title: A frozen backbone, an editable memory
caption: Architecture schematic. Memory intervenes after the final attention residual and before the final feed-forward sublayer; the base parameters remain frozen.

title: Writing a source-to-donor displacement

title: Retrieval is a gate, not an answer guarantee

title: Exact-source identity and its boundary
caption: Algebraic illustration. Exact-source transplantation reproduces the donor state, whereas a nearby source retains an error term and need not reproduce the answer.
